acceptedAnswer.text: Yes, City Dweller, LLC offers minor carpentry services tailored to interior home needs. This includes repairing or adjusting kitchen and bathroom cabinets, replacing damaged baseboards or crown molding, and fixing interior door frames. We also handle tasks like repairing wobbly handrails or installing shelving. These services help improve the functionality and aesthetic appeal of your home's interior spaces.
